android.title: Up to Date Firmware
android.description: Firmware updates include critical security fixes. Verify the patch level is current.
android.rationale: Reduces the probability of an attacker remotely exploiting the device.

android.title: Enabled Lock Screen
android.description: Verify that a Pattern, PIN or Password has been set. Swipe (type 17) and None (type 0) are non-compliant.
android.rationale: Enabling Screen Lock requires user authentication, which improves device security.

android.title: "Make Pattern Visible" is Disabled
steps: If "Screen lock" has "Pattern" underneath the text, follow further steps. If not, then this recommendation is not applicable.
Tap the "Gear Icon" next to "Screen lock".
android.description: Disable pattern visibility if using a pattern as device lock mechanism. Verify manually in Settings > Lock Screen.
android.rationale: Keeping unlock patterns visible can reveal the pattern and is vulnerable to shoulder surfing attacks.

android.title: "Automatically Lock" is set to "Immediately"
android.description: Immediately lock the phone as soon as the device goes to sleep.The recommended state for this setting is: Immediately.
android.rationale: Automatically and immediately locking the device as soon as it goes to sleep ensures there is no delay between the device entering the sleep state and the device being locked.

android.title: "Power Button Instantly Locks" is set to "Enabled"
steps: Tap the Gear icon next to "Screen lock".
Toggle "Power button instantly locks" setting to "ON" position.
android.description: Pressing the power button should lock the device instantly.
android.rationale: Enabling Power button instantly locks setting ensures that the device is instantly locked as well. This avoids a possible situation where a device is asleep but not locked and would be vulnerable to unauthorized use.

android.title: "Lock Screen Message" is Configured
android.description: Set a message to be displayed on the locked screen. The recommended state for this setting is: Configure Lock Screen Message.
android.rationale: When device screen is locked, a lock screen message helps to provide: Deterrent warnings; Device recognition without needing to unlock the device; Emergency contact information.

android.title: Do Not Connect to Untrusted Wi-Fi Networks
steps: Toggle "Wi-Fi" setting to the Off position or connect to a trusted network.
android.description: The Do not connect to untrusted Wi-Fi networks setting protects users from potential security threats when connecting to Wi-Fi networks. When this setting is enabled, the device will automatically avoid connecting to any Wi-Fi networks that it deems untrusted, based on a set of predefined criteria.
android.rationale: Connecting a device to an open untrusted network through unsecured channels can increase the remote attack surface of the device. The cellular data network is a more difficult medium to inspect compared to Wi-Fi. If a user is going to be using public Wi-Fi, using a secure VPN is recommended. In most cases, you should avoid using a public, untrusted or free Wi-Fi.

android.title: Ensure "Show Password" is set to "Disabled"
android.description: This setting controls whether passwords typed into a user's Android device are visible on screen or hidden. When this setting is disabled, the password is concealed, and only the most recent character is visible for a short time after it has been pressed.
android.rationale: Disabling this setting prevents potential shoulder surfing attacks.

android.title: Ensure "Developer Options" is set to "Disabled"
android.description: The Developer Options is a hidden settings menu on Android devices that provides advanced tools and options for developers and advanced users.
android.rationale: Enabling Developer Options allows a user to alter specific, very advanced settings on the device. This can severely affect how the device functions and expose additional developmental features to the user. This also exposes the device to respond to features such as USB debugging (when enabled) and other features that could be exploited to gain malicious access to the device sub-systems.

android.title: Ensure "Install Unknown Apps" is set to "Disabled"
steps: Toggle "Allow from this source" to "OFF" position.
android.description: Check Settings > Apps > Special Access > Install Unknown Apps and ensure no apps have this permission enabled.
android.rationale: Disabling installation from untrusted distribution channels protects against the inadvertent installation of untrusted or malicious applications. Google Play Apps are vetted by the Google Security Team and are generally considered safe. Installing apps from other sources can increase the risk of downloading malware or apps that may compromise user privacy and security. Therefore, it is recommended that users avoid installing apps from untrusted distribution channels.

android.title: Do not "Root" a User Device
android.description: Rooting an Android device means gaining administrative access to the device's system files and settings. This allows users to install custom firmware, modify system files, and perform other advanced operations that are not possible with a standard, unrooted device.
android.rationale: Rooting an Android device breaks the user-level restrictions set by Google. In addition, rooting enables any form of alteration to the device, which could allow privileged actions. As a result, rooting puts the device at greater risk because rooting can modify the device without restrictions. Rooting also voids the warranty and could make installing future security updates is problematic.

android.title: "Extend Unlock" is set to "Disabled"
android.description: Find My Device allows users to remotely locate, lock, or erase their device in case it is lost or stolen.
android.rationale: By enabling Find My Device, a user can remotely locate the device, ring the device, lock, or erase the device data. This helps to protect any sensitive data or personal information that may be stored on the device. It also increases the chances of recovering the device or having it returned to the owner, as it can provide location information to law enforcement or other authorities.

android.title: Ensure "Find My Device" is set to "Enabled"
android.description: Find My Device allows users to remotely locate, lock, or erase their device in case it is lost or stolen. The recommended state for this setting is: Enabled.
android.rationale: Knowing that this feature is locked behind an app, namely the "Find Hub", released by Google, we cannot properly identify if this setting is enabled by the user, as it needs to read values from inside another app.

android.title: Ensure "Use network-provided time" is set to "Enabled"
Ensure "Use network-provided time zone" is set to "Enabled"
Ensure "Remotely locate this device" is set to "Enabled"
android.description: The "Remotely locate this device" setting allows users to locate their lost or stolen device remotely, as long as it is connected to the internet. By enabling this feature, users can easily track the location of their device on a map, lock it remotely with a custom message and phone number, and even erase all data on the device to protect sensitive information.
android.rationale: By enabling the Remotely locate this device setting users can quickly and easily locate their lost or stolen device, and take action to protect their data and privacy.

android.title: Ensure "Allow remote lock and erase" is set to "Enabled"
android.description: The allow remote lock and erase setting allows users to remotely lock their device with a new passcode or erase all data in the event of loss or theft.
android.rationale: Allow remote lock and erase setting helps a user to remotely lock a device or erase data through Find My Device. This helps to safeguard privacy and protect data from unsanctioned access.

android.title: Ensure 'App protection' is set to 'Enabled'
steps: Toggle "Scan device for security threats" setting to "ON" position.
android.description: Samsung's built-in malware scanner provided by Device Care.
android.rationale: App Protection provides local, on-device signature scanning to detect malicious applications that may have bypassed the initial Play Store checks.

android.title: Ensure "Improve harmful app detection" is set to "Enabled"
steps: Toggle "Improve harmful app detection" setting to "ON" position.
android.description: The "Improve harmful app detection" setting enables Google to scan apps on the device in real-time, analyze their behavior, and compare them against a database of known malicious apps.
android.rationale: Enabling "Improve harmful app detection" setting sends anonymous information to Google about non-Google Play apps to enhance the detection and prevention of harmful apps, ultimately enhancing the security of Android devices and benefiting all users.

android.title: Ensure "Ask for unlock pattern/PIN/password before unpinning' is set to 'Enabled"
android.description: A user can pin an app and hand the device to a friend. With the screen pinned, the friend can use only that app. To use the other apps again, the user can unpin the screen.
android.rationale: A user might lend their device to a friend or anyone else to carry out a single task, such as playing a game. Screen pinning, in such a situation, locks the user to a particular screen, preventing accidental or malicious unpinning and preserving the confidentiality of the device's data. Users cannot use the device outside of the pinned application until the screen is unpinned. Unpinning the screen should require user re-authentication.

android.title: Ensure "Screen Timeout" is set to "2 minutes"
android.description: The Screen timeout setting allows users to specify the amount of time that elapses before the device's screen automatically turns off.
android.rationale: Setting an inactivity timeout is a recommended security measure to prevent unauthorized access to the device when it's unattended. The inactivity timeout automatically turns off the screen after a specified period of inactivity and also activates other security features like a screen lock to safeguard the device. This helps protect sensitive information from unauthorized access and enhances the overall security of the device.

android.title: Ensure "Wi-Fi assistant" is set to "Disabled"
android.description: The Wi-Fi assistant setting allows users to automatically connect to high-quality open Wi-Fi networks.
android.rationale: Wi-Fi assistant connects to any open Wi-Fi and tunnels the connection through Google VPN servers. It is considered best practice to only connect to trusted networks manually and leave this setting disabled.

android.title: Keep device Apps up to date
steps: Launch "Play Store" App in the App drawer.
f there are any updates pending, then tap "Update All".
android.description: Regularly update device apps. The recommended state for this setting is: Update apps
android.rationale: Enabling Keep device Apps up to date ensures that apps are always up to date with the latest features and security fixes without the need for manual updates.

android.title: Ensure "Add users from lock screen" is set to "Disabled"
steps: Launch "Play Store" App in the App drawer.
If there are any updates pending, then tap "Update All".
android.description: The Add users from lock screen setting allows users to add new users to the device from the lock screen without having to enter the primary user's password.
android.rationale: Users and the guest profile can do most of the same things as the device's owner, but each profile has its own storage space. As a result, guests could install malicious apps nor carry out other activities that compromise overall device security. Therefore, addin nusers from the lock screen setting should be disabled.

android.title: Ensure "Guest profiles" do not exist
android.description: Do not add any guest profiles on the device. Guest profiles allows users to create temporary profiles for guests or other individuals who may need to use the device without accessing the owner's personal data.
android.rationale: Users and the guest profile can do most of the same things as the device's owner, but each profile has its own storage space. As a result, guests could install malicious apps or carry out other activities that compromise overall device security. Therefore, adding any guest profiles on the device is not recommended.

android.title: Review app permissions periodically
steps: Tap on each permission and review the apps that have them.
Disable the app permissions that are over-permissive.
android.description: Review device app's permissions periodically. App permissions allow control over which capabilities or information apps could access on the device. Permissions can extend from using device hardware to accessing data.
android.rationale: Periodically reviewing all apps permissions ensures that those apps have legitimate permissions and only have access to data they actually need. Uninstall apps that may seek overbroad permissions.

android.title: Ensure "Bluetooth" Pairing is Configured
android.description: Bluetooth provides wireless connections to a wide range of devices like handsfree headsets, internet sharing and data transfer.
android.rationale: Some Bluetooth profiles provide for transfer of data without encryption or may be in violation of organization security policies and therefore should be disabled.

android.title: Ensure that no 3rd party keyboard are installed.
android.description: A number of 3rd party custom keyboards are available for Android devices.
android.rationale: Many 3rd party keyboards have been known to contain malware and provide an easy method to capture keystrokes.

android.title: Review existing user profiles periodically
android.description: Review any user profiles on the device. Remove those that are no longer required.
android.rationale: Users and the guest profile can do most of the same things as the device's owner, but each profile has its own storage space. As a result, additional users could install malicious apps or carry out other activities that compromise overall device security. Therefore, reviewing and removing unnecessary user profiles should be done periodically.

android.title: Ensure "Lock Screen" is set to "Don't Show Notifications at All"
android.description: Disable notifications on the lock screen. The recommended state for this setting is: Don't show notifications at all.
android.rationale: If the device is lost or unattended, disabling notifications prevents the information from appearing on the lock screen. This information might be confidential, and thus unwarranted disclosures could be avoided.

android.title: Ensure "Back up to Google Drive" is "Disabled"
android.description: Disable Backup to Google Drive.
android.rationale: If a user can back up corporate device data to a personal Google account, the user can later restore the information to a new device. Because of privacy concerns, backing up personal data such as text messages, emails, photos, and contacts to any third party is not recommended.

android.title: Ensure "Web and App Activity" is set to "Disabled"
steps: Toggle "Web & App Activity" setting to "OFF" position
android.description: Disable linking of web and app activity to your account when you are logged out
android.rationale: When this setting is enabled, searches and activity from other Google services are linked and saved to the Google Account. This could be privacy-invasive, so it is recommended to disable this setting.

android.title: Ensure "Device Information" is set to "Disabled"
android.description: Disable storing device information to your account.
android.rationale: When the Device Information setting is enabled, contact lists, calendars, alarms, and applications are saved to provide a personalized experience. The Device Information setting saves this data and replicates the information on Google's servers. It is recommended to disable this setting as it could be considered a privacy issue for the organization.

android.title: Ensure "Voice & Audio Activity" is set to "Disabled"
steps: Toggle "Voice & Audio Activity" setting to "OFF" position.
android.description: Disable saving your voice and other audio to your Google Account.
android.rationale: Google records your voice and other audio when you use audio activations. Audio can be saved even when your device is offline. When Voice & Audio Activity is off, voice inputs won't be saved to your Google Account, even if you're signed in. Instead, they may only be saved using anonymous identifiers. It is recommended to disable this setting as it could be considered a privacy issue for the organization.

android.title: Ensure "YouTube Search History" is set to "Disabled"
steps: Toggle "YouTube Search History" setting to "OFF" position.
android.description: Disable storing YouTube Search History to a user's account.
android.rationale: Turning on the YouTube Search History setting stores all YouTube searches to the user's Google account. YouTube and Google search history influences the recommendations seen on the YouTube homepage. It is recommended to disable this setting as it could be considered a privacy issue for the organization.

android.title: Ensure "YouTube Watch History" is set to "Disabled"
steps: Toggle "YouTube Watch History" setting to "OFF" position.
android.description: Disable storing YouTube Watch History to a user account.
android.rationale: Turning on the YouTube Watch History setting stores all YouTube watch history to the user's Google account. YouTube and Google watch history influences the recommendations seen on the YouTube homepage. It is recommended to disable this setting as it could be considered a privacy issue for the organization.

android.title: Ensure "Google Location History" is set to "Disabled"
steps: Toggle "Google Location History" setting to "OFF" position.
android.description: Disable storing device location history.
android.rationale: When the Google Location History setting is enabled, the device periodically sends diagnostic information to Google. This setting stores location history to provide results and recommendations across Google products. It is recommended to disable this setting as it could be considered a privacy issue for the organization.

android.title: Ensure "Opt out of Ads Personalization" is set to "Enabled"
steps: Toggle "Opt out of Ads Personalization" setting to "ON" position.
android.description: The Opt out of Ads Personalization setting allows users to control how their data is used for personalized advertising.
android.rationale: Apps leverage the app/browsing data to build a profile for displaying personalized ads. Disabling this setting prevents building profiles from various app/browsing activities to protect privacy.

android.title: Ensure "Wi-Fi scanning" Is "Disabled"
android.description: Wi-Fi scanning is a feature that allows your device to continuously scan for nearby Wi-Fi networks even when Wi-Fi is turned off. While it's used to improve location accuracy for services like Google Maps and Find My Phone, it also presents some security and privacy risks.
android.rationale: Wi-Fi scanning can make you vulnerable to attacks, especially when your device is configured to automatically connect to known networks. Threat actors can set up an "evil twin" network — a fake Wi-Fi access point with a common name like "Free Public Wi-Fi." Your phone might automatically connect to this malicious network, allowing the attacker to intercept your data and/or distribute malware.

android.title: Ensure "Bluetooth scanning" Is "Disabled"
android.description: Bluetooth scanning allows the device to find nearby Bluetooth devices and services, even when Bluetooth is turned off. This feature, part of location services, is mainly for improving location accuracy but carries significant security and privacy risks.
android.rationale: Bluetooth scanning can be used to track your location. By continuously collecting the MAC addresses of nearby Bluetooth devices, this data can be used to create a detailed record of your movements. Malicious actors could potentially use this information to monitor your routine and habits. Although newer Android versions use randomized MAC addresses to mitigate some of this risk, it is still a concern.

android.title: Ensure "Microphone" permission in Chrome is set to "Ask first"
android.description: This setting controls if a site asks before accessing the microphone.
android.rationale: Websites will have to ask permission before being allowed to access the microphone, which will help prevent unwanted access to the microphone and help protect against potential privacy concerns.

android.title: Ensure "Location" is set to "Enabled"
android.description: This setting controls if a site asks before accessing the location,
android.rationale: Websites will have to ask permission before being allowed to access the location, which will help prevent unwanted access to the user's location and help protect against potential privacy concerns.

android.title: Ensure "Allow third-party cookies" is set to "Disabled"
android.description: A third-party cookie is sent by a domain that differs from the domain in the browser's address bar.
android.rationale: Blocking third-party cookies can help protect users' privacy by eliminating several website tracking cookies.

android.title: Ensure "Safe Browsing" is set to "Enabled"
android.description: This setting controls the "Safe Browsing" feature.
android.rationale: Google Safe Browsing helps protect devices by warning users when they attempt to navigate dangerous sites or download harmful files.

android.title: Ensure "Search and URL suggestions" is set to "Disabled"
steps: Uncheck the "Search and URL suggestions" checkbox.
android.description: Google Chrome uses a prediction service to show related searches, matches from browsing history, and popular websites while a user types in the address bar.
android.rationale: Having search suggestions processed is considered a privacy concern.

android.title: Ensure "Do Not Track" is set to "Enabled"
steps: "Toggle" the "Do Not Track" to the "ON" position.
android.description: When browsing the web on computers or Android devices, users can request websites not to collect or track browsing data. Note: Chrome doesn't provide details of which websites and web services respect "Do Not Track" requests and how websites interpret them.
android.rationale: Many websites will still collect and use browsing data to improve security, provide content, services, ads, and recommendations on their websites, and generate reporting statistics.

ios.title: Ensure a  "Consent Message " has been Configured
steps: Open the CIS Profile builder in this tool.
Generate and install the profile. The consent message appears during installation.
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to the configuration of a consent message shown at the time of a configuration profile installation.
ios.rationale: In this section of the benchmark, recommendations are for devices that are owned by the end user. They are voluntarily accepting the configuration profile and should be provided an explicit opportunity to consent.

ios.title: Ensure "Controls when the profile can be removed" is set to "Always"
steps: In the left window pane, click on the "General" tab
In the right window pane, under the heading "Security", set the menu "Controls when the profile can be removed" to "Always".
Verify "Remove Profile" is displayed near the bottom of the screen.
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to the removal of a given configuration profile.
ios.rationale: In this section of the benchmark, recommendations are for devices that are owned by the end user. They are voluntarily accepting the configuration profile and should be able to remove it at will.

ios.title: Ensure "Allow Siri while device is locked" is set to "Disabled"
steps: Open the CIS Profile builder in this tool.
Rule 2.2.1.1 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to accessing Siri while the device is locked.
ios.rationale: Accessing Siri on a locked device may allow unauthorized users to access information otherwise not available to them, such as messaging, contacts, and a variety of other data

ios.title: Ensure "Allow managed apps to store data in iCloud" is set to "Disabled"
steps: Download and install the CIS profile from this tool.
Rule 2.2.1.2 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to managed applications storing and syncing data through iCloud.
ios.rationale: This recommendation addresses data leakage. It prevents a user from installing an application that is managed by the organization on a personal device and allowing iCloud to sync the managed application's data to the personal, non-managed application

ios.title: Ensure "Force encrypted backups" is set to "Enabled"
steps: Download and install the CIS profile from this tool.
Rule 2.2.1.3 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to iTunes backup encryption of iOS and iPadOS devices.
ios.rationale: Data that are stored securely on an iOS or iPadOS device may be trivially accessed from a local computer backup. Forcing the encryption of backups protects data from being compromised if the local host computer is compromised. Use of backups is strongly advised as they allow the creation of a copy of data that can be recovered in the event of failures, such as hardware or software failure, data corruption, human-caused event, or accidental deletion of data. Backup copies allow data to be restored from an earlier point in time to help recover from an unexpected event.

ios.title: Ensure "Allow personalized ads delivered by Apple" is set to "Disabled"
steps: In the left window pane, click on the "Restrictions" tab
In the right window pane, under the tab "Functionality", uncheck the checkbox for Allow personalized ads delivered by Apple.
ios.description: Apple provides a framework that allows advertisers to target Apple users with advertisements relevant to them and their interests by means of a unique identifier. For such personalized advertisements to be delivered, however, detailed information is collected, correlated, and made available to advertisers. This information is valuable to both advertisers and attackers and has been used with other metadata to reveal users' identities
ios.rationale: Disabling the use of a unique identifier helps hinder the tracking of users, which in turn supports protection of user data.

ios.title: Ensure "Allow users to accept untrusted TLS certificates" is set to "Disabled"
steps: Download and install the CIS profile from this tool.
Rule 2.2.1.5 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to the acceptance of untrusted TLS certificates.
ios.rationale: iOS devices maintain a list of trusted TLS certificate roots. An organization may add their own certificates to the list by using a configuration profile. Allowing users to bypass that list and accept self-signed or otherwise unverified certificates may increase the likelihood of an incident.

ios.title: Ensure "Force automatic date and time" is set to "Enabled"
steps: In the left window pane, click on the "Restrictions" tab
In the right window pane, under the tab "Functionality", uncheck the checkbox for "Force automatic date and time".
ios.description: It is possible to automatically set the date and time on devices running iOS 12 and later. The time zone updates only when the device can determine its location, such as when a device has a cellular connection or a Wi-Fi connection with location services enabled.
ios.rationale: Correct date and time settings are required for authentication protocols, file creation, modification dates, and log entries.

ios.title: Ensure "Allow documents from managed sources in unmanaged destinations" is set to "Disabled"
steps: Download and install the CIS profile from this tool.
Rule 2.2.1.7 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to Apple's managed application implementation. The terms "managed" and "unmanaged" refer to application classifications made through Managed Open In, a feature introduced in iOS 7. Managed Open In provides for data containerization. Institutionally-provisioned applications are designated as managed. Applications elected by the end user are designated as unmanaged.
ios.rationale: Limiting data transfer from the managed institutional application space to the unmanaged user space may prevent data leakage.

ios.title: Ensure "Allow documents from unmanaged sources in managed destinations" is set to "Disabled"
steps: Download and install the CIS profile from this tool.
Rule 2.2.1.8 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to Apple's managed application implementation. The terms "managed" and "unmanaged" refer to application classifications made through Managed Open In, a feature introduced in iOS 7. Managed Open In provides for data containerization. Institutionally-provisioned applications are designated as managed. Applications elected by the end user are designated as unmanaged.
ios.rationale: Limiting data transfer from the unmanaged user application space to the managed institutional space limits institutional resources from being employed for personal use.

ios.title: Ensure "Treat AirDrop as unmanaged destination" is set to "Enabled"
steps: Download and install the CIS profile from this tool.
Rule 2.2.1.9 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to AirDrop in the context of Apple's managed app implementation. The terms "managed" and "unmanaged" refer to application classifications made through Managed Open In, a feature introduced in iOS 7. Managed Open In provides for data containerization. Institutionally-provisioned applications are designated as managed. Applications elected by the end user are designated as unmanaged.
ios.rationale: When AirDrop is allowed as a managed destination, sensitive data may be moved out of the managed application space to an unmanaged device.

ios.title: Ensure "Allow Handoff" is set to "Disabled"
steps: Download and install the CIS profile from this tool.
Rule 2.2.1.10 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to Apple's Handoff data-sharing mechanism.
ios.rationale: Handoff does not enforce managed application boundaries. This allows managed application data to be moved to the unmanaged application space on another device, which may result in data leakage.

ios.title: Ensure "Allow sending diagnostic and usage data to Apple" is set to "Disabled"
steps: In the left window pane, click on the "Restrictions" tab
In the right window pane, under the tab "Functionality", uncheck the checkbox for "Allow sending diagnostic and usage data to Apple".
ios.description: Apple provides a mechanism to send diagnostic and analytics data back to them in order help improve the platform. This information sent to Apple may contain internal organizational information that should not be disclosed to third parties.
ios.rationale: Organizations should have knowledge of what is shared with vendors and other third parties, and should also be in full control of what is disclosed.

ios.title: Ensure "Force Apple Watch wrist detection" is set to "Enabled"
steps: Download and install the CIS profile from this tool.
Rule 2.2.1.12 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to configuring wrist detection on paired Apple Watches.
ios.rationale: Wrist detection prevents a removed Apple Watch from providing access to information not otherwise available.

ios.title: Ensure "Show Control Center in Lock screen" is set to "Disabled"
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to the display of Control Center on the lock screen.
ios.rationale: When a device is lost or stolen, the Control Center may be used to enable airplane mode, thus preventing locating or erasing the device. Disabling Control Center forces a malicious actor to power down the device, which then discards the encryption key in memory. This makes some attacks based on physical possession more difficult.
steps: Download and install the CIS profile from this tool.
Rule 2.2.1.13 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.

ios.title: Ensure "Show Notification Center in Lock screen" is set to "Disabled"
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to the display of Notification Center on the lock screen.
ios.rationale: Communications between the operating system and applications to a user should be controlled to prevent data leakage or exploitation. For example, some two-factor authentication applications will present the option to allow a login from a new device in notification center on the lock screen..
steps: Download and install the CIS profile from this tool.
Rule 2.2.1.14 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.

ios.title: Ensure "Force fraud warning" is set to "Enabled"
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to the Safari feature which warns end users about visiting suspected fraudulent websites.
ios.rationale: Fraudulent websites masquerade as legitimate instances of financial, business, or other sensitive sites. They are designed to capture user credentials, often through phishing campaigns. Safari's fraudulent website warning feature helps protect end users from such sites.
steps: Download and install the CIS profile from this tool.
Rule 2.2.2.1 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.

ios.title: Ensure "Accept cookies" is set to "From websites I visit" or "From current website only"
ios.description: Safari should only accept cookies from visited websites.
ios.rationale: Accepting cookies may allow web servers to interact with other cookies already in place. For example, the HEIST cookie exploit allows for retrieving data from cookies stored on a device. Cookies often follow poor coding practices and include authentication properties. Limiting acceptance of cookies to only those from sites intentionally visited reduces the likelihood of a potential exploit.
steps: Download and install the CIS profile from this tool.
Rule 2.2.2.2 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.

ios.title: Ensure "Managed Safari Web Domains" is Configured
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to whether Safari, as well as Mobile Device Management (MDM) deployed browsers, will consider certain URL patterns for managed application spaces only.
ios.rationale: Sensitive files available from a website may be downloaded into the unmanaged application spaces by default. By configuring specific domains that Safari should consider managed, an institution may support the secure containerization of their data.
steps: Consult your IT administrator to define appropriate managed web domains.
Apply via a custom configuration profile.

ios.title: Ensure "Allow simple value" is set to "Disabled"
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to passcode requirements. A simple passcode is defined as containing repeated characters, or increasing/decreasing characters (such as 123 or CBA).
ios.rationale: Simple passcodes include repeating, ascending, or descending character sequences that may be easily guessed.
steps: Download and install the CIS profile from this tool.
Rule 2.4.1 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.

ios.title: Ensure "Require alphanumeric value" is set to "Enabled"
ios.description: Passwords set by users must contain at least one letter and one number.
ios.rationale: Complex passwords are more resistant against persons seeking unauthorized access to a system.
steps: In the left window pane, click on the "Passcode" tab.
In the right window pane, check the checkbox for "Require alphanumeric value".

ios.title: Ensure "Minimum passcode length " is set to 6 or greater
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to minimum passcode length.
ios.rationale: Requiring at least six character minimum length provides reasonable assurance against passcode attacks.
steps: Download and install the CIS profile from this tool.
Rule 2.4.3 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.

ios.title: Ensure "Maximum Auto-Lock" is set to 2 minutes or less
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to the maximum number of minutes a device may remain inactive before auto-locking.
ios.rationale: Automatically locking the device after a short period of inactivity reduces the probability nof an attacker accessing the device without entering a passcode.
steps: Download and install the CIS profile from this tool.
Rule 2.4.4 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.

ios.title: Ensure "Maximum grace period for device lock" is set to "Immediately"
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to the amount of time a device may be unlocked without entering a passcode after that device has been locked. Devices with TouchID enabled do not allow a grace period.
ios.rationale: Configuring the "Maximum grace period for device lock" to "Immediately" precludes unauthenticated access when waking the device.
steps: Download and install the CIS profile from this tool.
Rule 2.4.5 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.

ios.title: Ensure "Maximum number of failed attempts" is set to 6
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to the number of attempted logins before automatic deletion of a device's cryptographic key.
ios.rationale: Excessive incorrect passcode attempts typically indicate that the owner has lost physical control of the device. In the event of such an incident, erasing the encryption key will help to ensure confidentiality of information stored on the device.
steps: Download and install the CIS profile from this tool.
Rule 2.4.6 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.

ios.title: Ensure "Disable Association MAC Randomization" is Configured
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to disabling MAC randomization as needed.
ios.rationale: MAC randomization is a feature available from iOS 14 onward and is enabled by default. Although this feature enhances privacy for individuals by using random and different addresses for each Wi-Fi network, it can lead to problems in some circumstances, such as captive portals, MAC-based Access Control Lists, etc. In such cases, disabling this feature may be necessary. This is a per-network setting, meaning it can be turned off for specific networks only.
steps: In the left window pane, click on the "Wi-Fi" tab.
In the right window pane, select the relevant Wi-Fi configuration.
In the right window pane, check the checkbox for "Disable Association MAC Randomization".

ios.title: Ensure "VPN" is Configured
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to establishing a virtual private network (VPN) connection when appropriate
ios.rationale: The network to which a device connects provides important services that may be exploited by a malicious actor. Establishing a VPN mitigates the associated risks by encrypting data in transit and using known good network services, such as DNS.
steps: In the left window pane, click on the "VPN" tab.
In the right window pane, enter an appropriate VPN configuration.

ios.title: Ensure "Allow user to move messages from this account" is set to "Disabled"
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to whether a message can be moved from an institutionally-configured mail account to an end user-configured mail account. It also limits forwarding or replying from a different account than the one from which the message originated.
ios.rationale: Allowing the movement of messages from a managed email account to an unmanaged email account may result in data leakage.
steps: Download and install the CIS profile from this tool.
Rule 2.7.1 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.

ios.title: Ensure"Allow Mail Drop" is set to "Disabled"
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to whether a message attachment can be uploaded or accessed through Apple's Mail Drop service.
ios.rationale: Permitting attachment uploads to Mail Drop, which is outside organizational control, presents a data exfiltration path.
steps: Download and install the CIS profile from this tool.
Rule 2.7.2 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.

ios.title: Ensure"Notification Settings" are configured for all Managed Apps
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to the configuration of notification settings on a per- application basis.
ios.rationale: Notifications may include sensitive data or might allow for privileged actions to take place. All managed applications must include explicit notification settings in order to address these concerns.
steps: In the left window pane, click on the Notifications tab.
In the right window pane, click Configure and/or click the + to add notification settings on a per-app basis.

ios.title: Ensure External Intelligence Extensions is Disabled
ios.description:
The External Intelligence Extensions allows Apple Intelligence to interface with 3rd part generative AI tools. Apple's external intelligence extension represents a calculated risk. They are extending their on-device privacy and security model to the
cloud with PCC (Private Cloud Compute), and then carefully integrating with a third-party AI like ChatGPT, emphasizing user consent, data minimization, and strong contractual obligations. The inherent nature of sending data to an external service means a degree of trust is placed on that third party's security posture and adherence to agreements. Sending data to an external service is an additional risk, however, that must be reviewed and accepted in an organizational security plan.
ios.rationale: While Apple has put significant effort into designing Apple Intelligence with a privacy-first approach, the external intelligence extension introduces legitimate security risks that might lead an individual or organization to disable it..
steps: Download and install the CIS profile from this tool.
Rule 2.9.1 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.

ios.title: Ensure Notes Summarization is Disabled
ios.description: Apple Intelligence's Notes summarization feature quickly condenses content within the Notes app. This includes summarizing written text you've highlighted or, notably, automatically generating summaries from audio recordings taken directly within Notes, like lectures or meetings, helping you grasp key information at a glance.
ios.rationale: Disabling Notes summarization is wise for security if your audio recordings or notes contain very private or sensitive information. While Apple usually keeps your data secure, turning this off ensures none of that sensitive content, especially from transcribed audio, ever leaves your device for any AI processing, giving you maximum control over your confidential data.
steps: Download and install the CIS profile from this tool.
Rule 2.9.2 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.

ios.title: Ensure Mail Summarization is Disabled
ios.description: Apple Intelligence's Mail summarization feature uses AI to quickly condense long emails or entire email threads into a few key sentences or bullet points. It automatically appears as a short summary under emails in your inbox, or you can manually tap a "Summarize" button within an open email to get a more detailed overview of complex messages and conversations, helping you grasp the main points at a glance without reading everything.
ios.rationale:
If there's any concern that your sensitive email content, even if for summarization, might potentially be routed to this third-party service (even with consent prompts), or if you want to avoid any possibility of Apple's servers processing data from highly confidential
communications (even within PCC's strong safeguards), disabling the feature ensures your mail content is processed via approved organizational services and on managed devices. This prioritizes absolute control and minimizes any external processing risk for highly sensitive information.
steps: Download and install the CIS profile from this tool.
Rule 2.9.3 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.

ios.title: Ensure Writing Tools is Disabled
ios.description: Apple Intelligence Writing Tools are a suite of AI-powered features integrated across iOS, iPadOS, and macOS, enabling users to enhance their text by proofreading for errors, rewriting content to adjust tone or style, summarizing lengthy passages into concise forms, and even composing new text from scratch. While many of these functions process securely on-device, there is the possibility of leveraging Apple's private cloud infrastructure.
ios.rationale: The core of the security argument for disabling Apple Intelligence's Writing Tools revolves around unacceptable risk exposure to third parties and the potential for unintended data leakage. For individuals or organizations handling sensitive, confidential, or regulated data, the perceived risks of third-party exposure, potential for accidental data leakage, and compliance challenges often outweigh the convenience benefits. Disabling this feature is a rational and proactive security measure.
steps: Download and install the CIS profile from this tool.
Rule 2.9.4 is included in the profile and enforced automatically.

ios.title: Review Manage Sharing & Access
ios.description: Managing Sharing & Access is a new feature available with iOS 16, which allows users to review what is being shared with people and apps via a wizard to determine if current settings are adequate or if some access needs to be revoked. It also allows the review of settings related to a user's Apple ID.
ios.rationale: By regularly reviewing what is being shared with apps and people, and by reviewing the Apple ID settings, users can ensure sharing settings are accurate and that their Apple ID is kept safe.
steps: Remove sharing from any applications or people that are outside your organization's requirements.
Tap "Done" at the end of the procedure.

ios.title: Review Emergency Reset
ios.description:
Emergency Reset is a one-tap option that allows user protection by revoking everything an iOS device is sharing with all people and apps, including things like location information, home data, photo albums and more.
Emergency Reset also allows users to remove all emergency contacts and reset their Apple ID and password so that no one can log into their account.
ios.ratioanle:
Emergency Reset is designed for people who are experiencing or at risk of domestic abuse, but it's also useful for anyone who has ever shared their location or data with partners in the pa  st. The tool is a centralized dashboard of controls meant to simplify resetting privacy permissions, revoking location access and auditing data sharing.
Monitoring smartphones is a common tactic in domestic abuse situations because it takes advantage of everyday tools, such as iCloud or location sharing. By cutting off an abuser's access to a device it is possible to mitigate the risks of being stalked or exposed.
steps: Follow the onscreen instructions until the procedure is complete.

ios.title: Review Lockdown Mode
ios.description:
Lockdown Mode is a new operational model made available with iOS. It ensures a high level of security by limiting or disabling a nummber of features of the device.
Lockdown Mode blocks most attachment types in Messages, blocks FaceTime calls from non-contacts, limits web browsing functions, prevents configuration profiles from being installed, and more, with a full list available in our Lockdown article.
ios.rationale: Lockdown Mode is meant for users who can be targeted by sophisticated cyberattacks (such as activists, journalists and others) and as such require an additional level of security.

ios.title: Ensure "App Privacy Report" is enabled
ios.description: App Privacy Report is a tool that provides details about how often apps access your data, such as location, camera, microphone, and more. The tool also returns information about each app's network activity and website network activity, as well as the web domains that all apps contact most frequently.
ios.rationale: By regularly using App Privacy Report, users can have a comprehensive picture of how their apps behave and how they use their data.
steps: Tap the services you want to disable or modify.

ios.title: Review Airprint
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to Apple's AirPrint, a feature for printing without installing printer-specific drivers.
ios.rationale: AirPrint does not enforce managed boundaries for printers. This allows the device to connect to any AirPrint compatible printer, which may result in data leakage.
steps: In the left window pane, click on the Restrictions tab.
In the right window pane, under the tab Functionality, uncheck the checkbox for Allow AirPrint (supervised only).

ios.title: Ensure device is not obviously jailbroken or compromised
ios.description:
This recommendation pertains to inspecting a device for the presence of the most
common jailbreak indicator.
ios.rationale:
Apple imposes certain restrictions on which apps can be installed on a device. Further, no app can gain access to information and data on the device or another app without being given authorization. This restricts the potential risk of unauthorized access by an app due to the limited administrative rights allowed by Apple. A compromised iOS device, both unintentionally in the event of a malicious actor and willingly as for jailbroken devices, may circumvent the above restrictions and in doing so may execute arbitrary code, compromise configuration profile requirements, or open the device to
exploits that are otherwise not possible.
steps: Connect the iOS device to the computer with a USB cable.
Select your iOS device within iTunes.
After restoration, set up as a new device or restore from a known good backup.

ios.title: Ensure "Install iOS Updates" of "Automatic Updates" is set to "Enabled"
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to the automatic installation of operating system updates.
ios.rationale: System updates may patch software vulnerabilities, therefore it is important that devices are kept up-to-date.
steps: Enable "Download iOS Updates" and "Install iOS Updates".

ios.title: Ensure "Software Update" returns "Your software is up to date"
ios.description:
This recommendation pertains to updating and upgrading the operating system of a
given device
ios.rationale:
An up-to-date operating system provides the best possible protection against the
execution of malicious code.
steps: Tap "Install" or "Download and Install" and then allow device to complete the installation.

ios.title: Review "iCloud Private Relay" settings
ios.description:
iCloud Private Relay is a service offered by Apple as part of an iCloud+ subscription. It allows users on iOS 15, iPadOS 15, macOS Monterey, or later versions of iOS, iPadOS, and macOS to browse the Web more privately by hiding the user's actual IP address. 
The service makes use of a multi-hop architecture whereby a user's requests are sent through two separate internet relays, operated by different entities, that replace a user's original IP address. 
The user's IP address is visible to the network provider and to the first relay, which is operated by Apple. The DNS records are encrypted, so neither party can see the address of the website the user is trying to visit. The second relay, which is operated by a third-party content provider, generates a temporary IP address, decrypts the name of the website, and connects to the site. By doing so, no single party - including Apple - can view or collect the details of a user's browsing activity or unencrypted activity in applications.
ios.rationale:
While browsing the Web, information contained in the Web traffic, such as DNS records and IP address, can be seen by a network provider and by any websites visited. This information could be used to determine a user's identity and build a profile of their
location and browsing history. Hiding this information prevents the tracking and profiling of users, resulting in an increased level of privacy while browsing the Web.
steps: Tap "<_The User's Name_>" where "Apple ID, iCloud, iTunes & App Store" is displayed beneath.

ios.title: Review "Mail Privacy Protection" settings
ios.description: Mail Privacy Protection helps protect user privacy by preventing email senders from learning information about the activity they engage with using the Mail application. When turned on, this feature hides user IP addresses.
ios.rationale:
By enabling Mail Privacy, senders cannot build a profile of a user's online activity or determine their location. Such a feature also prevents senders from seeing if users have opened the email they sent.
Hiding user IP addresses prevents user tracking and profiling, which results in an
increased level of privacy while using the Mail app.
steps: Verify that "Protect Mail Activity" is enabled.

ios.title: Ensure "Automatic Downloads" of "App Updates" is set to "Enabled"
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to the automatic installation of application updates.
ios.rationale: Application updates may patch software vulnerabilities.

ios.title: Ensure "Find My iPhone/iPad" is set to "Enabled"
ios.description:
This recommendation pertains to remote device locating, locking, and erasure by the
end user..
ios.rationale:
The ability to locate, lock, and erase a device remotely helps mitigate the impact of device theft and loss, as well as the likelihood of permanent loss.
This is only recommended for end user-owned devices. Institutionally-owned devices should not be erasable by end users.
steps: Tap "<_The User's Name_>" where "Apple ID, iCloud, iTunes & App Store" is displayed beneath.
Enable "Find My iPhone, Find My Network" and "Send Last Location".

ios.title: Ensure the latest iOS device architecture is used by high-value targets
ios.description: This recommendation pertains to the physical device(s) used by high-value targets.
ios.rationale: Physical security exploits against iOS devices are rarely demonstrated within two years of the release of the underlying architecture. For users whose physical iOS device(s) may be targeted, it is prudent to use the most recently released architecture.

ios.title: Verify iPhone Mirroring Settings
ios.description: iPhone Mirroring is a new feature offered in iOS 18 and macOS 15.0 Sequoia. It allows a macOS device to remotely access an iOS device connected to the same Apple Account. If a user has different Apple Accounts signed into iOS and macOS (ex. a managed Apple Account on macOS and a personal Apple Account on iOS) then there is no ability to mirror the iOS device on the macOS device.
ios.rationale:
Enabling iPhone Mirroring may allow a macOS device to capture data from an iOS device. This would occur where the macOS device has not been approved to access that information by your organization's policies and the iOS has been approved (or vice-versa). If iPhone Mirroring is currently in use on an iOS device, the lock screen with have a notification that states iPhone in Use and state what device is using it.
If iPhone Mirroring was in use on an iOS device but is no longer in use, the first time the user unlocks the iOS device it will notify the user that iPhone was used from Mac.
steps: Set "iPhone Mirroring" to your organization's requirements

ios.title: Ensure RCS Messaging is Enabled Instead of SMS/MMS Where Available
ios.description: RCS messaging should be used instead of SMS/MMS where available.
ios.rationale: RCS provides end-to-end encryption for messages, unlike SMS/MMS which transmit in plaintext.
